about.text: one of the very few spun paste sheep's milk cheeses. Produced in western Sicily, between the provinces of Palermo, Trapani and Agrigento, in the territories of the Valle del Belice.

sources.text: EU PDO from memory; English article only lists it as a PAT; ripening not stated

facts.v: Traditionally a summer cheese, now made all year round
